notes: Emberkin "Hearth Shield" (+1 layer while the room is hot): a gunmetal frame with a brass ring and four brass pylons topped with flame lamps, and in the middle a brass hearth bowl with a live flame under the dome. On loop (8): blue emitter segments turn round the hearth, arcs crawl between the pylons, the pylon flames take turns, the hearth flame flickers. hit (3): flare and ripple. recharge (4): the rings spin up. Damaged: the brass ring cracked, the west pylon dead, a flap hangs off the lower-right corner. Disabled: the bowl cold and split, the west pylon smashed, casing split.
